bug_semantics: POST /api/system/getConf is registered with CheckAuth only, so publish RoleReader tokens and anonymous publish readers (when Publish.Auth.Enable is false) can call it. getConf clones Conf via GetMaskedConf then, for non-administrators, HideConfSecret. Both stages are field-by-field blocklists. Three values that exportConf in the same file already clears were omitted from that blocklist and serialized to readers: CookieKey (gorilla/securecookie HMAC key for the siyuan session cookie), Export.PandocBin (absolute path embedding the OS username), and NotebookCrypto (encrypted-notebook key material). Forged session cookies follow from CookieKey disclosure; AccessAuthCode is masked, so admin impersonation additionally needs no access-auth code or another way to satisfy that check.
flaw_origin: The incomplete HideConfSecret blocklist was first written when read-only publish was added. It enumerated AI/API/flashcard/publish/repo/sync and some System paths, but not Export.PandocBin which already existed. Later CookieKey (2025-12-26) and NotebookCrypto (2026-07-04) were added to AppConf without extending the same blocklist, so they leaked by the same fail-open design until 2026-07-24/25 security patches.
